title: test_sign_verify_roundtrip_via_mime_tree uses code-under-test as oracle
description: smime_tests.rs Test E: calls sign() to produce signed_bytes, then calls verify() on the same bytes. sign() and verify() are both in smime-tree — the code under test. This proves sign()+verify() are mutually consistent but not that either is correct against an external oracle. RFC 4648 and S/MIME test vectors from OpenSSL or pyca/cryptography must be used. The test should instead: (a) use a pre-computed fixture signed by OpenSSL and verify it, or (b) sign with smime-tree, then verify with openssl smime -verify as the oracle (not verify()). Without an external oracle this test cannot detect a symmetric bug.
